segments.text: The main male character and the one the player takes the role of. Isshu is a third-year high school student. He lives alone in an apartment and doesn't worry much about school. His girlfriend is Inori, but she dumps him at the beginning of the game. He works in a cafe called Narazuya and is a co-worker of Haya.
Taken from Wikipedia.
A third-year high school student who belongs to the Naginata club. Ayumu has one-sided rivalry with Miyabi. Also, she speaks in Kansai dialect.
Taken from Wikipedia.
Likes: Green ramen.
The protagonist of this story and a Faculty of Arts sophomore at Chihaya University. He is Miumi's older cousin.

Haruto had decided to push himself on the way to become a hot-blooded man. He often presses himself all the way to his goal, even though this way he gains himself enemies. Every time there is romance involved, Haruto gets extremely embarrassed and his face becomes red because he's inexperienced in that field. He is the type of a person whose feelings overcome his theory and mind. Thus after loosing his best friend Yuusuke in an accident that took place one year ago, he had drawn himself away from his dream to create his own film.
Translated from the official site.

Chinatsu is a second-year student at the private Tōrin high school and is a classmate of Naoki's. In addition, she's Naoki's cousin ans childhhood friend. As Chinatsu is concerned about Naoki at all times, she commutes to school with him and is always around him during school hours. She appears to be an airhead, and a self-proclaimed bride of the hero.

This "bride" term is not entirely made up by her, in fact, Chinatsu was assigned to be Naoki's fiance from birth, but after Naoki's qualification of a heir to the Serizawa family has been deprived, their official unity has been broken. So Chinatsu has become the main heir of the Serizawa household.
[Taken from Wikipedia and translated from
Naoki is the protagonist of Yubikiri no Kioku. Naoki used to live at Chinatsu's home but is now living alone. Naoki is a second-year student at the private Tōrin high school.
Taken from Wikipedia.
Kasumi is a runaway girl who suddenly arrived at the doorsteps of Naoki's place and is forcibly living with him at the moment. She is calm and cool, high computing, but ignorant to love.
Taken from Wikipedia.
Orihime is the new math teacher for Naoki's class at Tōrin high school.
Taken from Wikipedia.

segments.text: Lisa is an American girl who has gone temporarily to Japan to study abroad. Lisa works part-time at a restaurant called Fuuruuyan and is where she meets Naoki. Lisa's reason for studying in Japan is because of her interest in Japanese history and culture.
Taken from Wikipedia.
Shiina is a first-year student at Tōrin high school. She is very outgoing and loves gossip.
Taken from Wikipedia.
Hobbies: Guitar.
Likes: Music in general, Ririsu.
Dislikes: Studying.

A second year student at Sumisora High School. While Tooru's a little bit of a luck-pusher, it was shown that his actions are not as great as his words. He is known in his school as a legendary useless person. Tooru plays the guitar. When it comes to music, he can listen to anything, from classical to death metal.
In "Next Relation", after getting a license, he purchases the motorcycle he always wanted.
In "Yubikiri no Kioku":
Childhood friend of Naoki and his friends.
After failing the college entrance examination, Tooru goes to a prep school while working part-time. He still is hopelessly in love with Ririsu.
Taken from Wikipedia and translated from the official site and the Japanese Wikipedia.

The interim manager of Fuuryuuan. Entrusted by the brass at "Ressac," his previous workplace, he brings his experience in customer service to Fuuryuuan, which is a traditional Japanese restaurant. Ever since he traveled all throughout Japan, he has gained a greater appreciation for the Edo period which he puts to great use. He looks out for his staff, generally being a reasonable and reliable boss. When he gets too out of hand, he gets kept in line by Okyou-san.
Kitchen staff leader of Fuuryuuan. A strong-minded and confident woman who plays the role on an elder sister. She hates being called by her last name, so Naoki and the rest call her "O-Kyoto-san".

She keeps calling all of the part-time workers of Fuuryuuan "Rookie No.*" whilst they are working there for part-time job since they usually keep hiring and quitting from one minute to the next because they can't stand the hard work.
Translated from the Japanese Wikipedia.
Her real name is Hinagishi Izumi (雛岸 いずみ) and she's Orihime's classmate from when she was a high school student.

A babysitter who used to raise Lisa in the United States when she was a child, a woman who was like a mother to her. Lisa seems to want to thank Chiyoko for raising her, but her whereabouts are unknown.
Translated from the Japanese Wikipedia.

Hew has been contacting Lisa many times from the United States, but their relationship is rather awkward.

Ryuuzou is Chinatsu's father and Naoki's uncle who raised him like his son after he was was abandoned by his parents.
Translated from the Japanese Wikipedia.
Kasumi's father. He tries to sell his daughter-in-law to a man of power without hesitation, all for the sake of his success and gaining a higher position.
Translated from the Japanese Wikipedia.
